school.school_name: 東京俳優・映画＆放送専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Preserve a Tokyo information-disclosure page where a confirmation-form PDF is image-only and cannot prove the rolling target fiscal year.
steps: Start from the Tokyo official-index disclosure URL registered as the school's prefecture_aggregator site.
Inspect the anchor labeled 確認申請書様式.
Classify it as needs_operator_review because the PDF is image-only and no URL or anchor evidence proves FY2026.

reusable_rules: Keep image-only 確認申請書 PDFs visible for operator review.
Do not accept image-only target-form candidates without OCR or reliable page/URL fiscal-year evidence.
Prefer the explicit 確認申請書様式 candidate over adjacent general information-disclosure PDFs.
anti_patterns: Do not drop an image-only confirmation form as generic non-target noise.
Do not count an image-only form as strict FY2026 success without target-year evidence.

evidence.notes: Windows v342 Tokyo 30-site replay records this candidate as reason=target_fiscal_year_not_detected, pdf_type=image_only, pattern_type=wordpress.
